description: Standard astronaut experiment procedure for BAS microgravity sample handling.

steps.label: Open Main Box
steps.description: Open the main experiment container lid.
steps.voice_prompt: Step one: Open the main box.
steps.completion_voice: Main box opened. Proceed to step two.

steps.label: Take Red Box
steps.description: Retrieve the red sample box from the main container.
steps.voice_prompt: Step two: Take the red box.
steps.completion_voice: Red box retrieved. Proceed to step three.

steps.label: Take Yellow Box
steps.description: Retrieve the yellow reagent box from the main container.
steps.voice_prompt: Step three: Take the yellow box.
steps.completion_voice: Yellow box retrieved. Proceed to step four.

steps.label: Open Red Box
steps.description: Open the red sample box to access the sample chamber.
steps.voice_prompt: Step four: Open the red box.
steps.completion_voice: Red box opened. Proceed to step five.

steps.label: Take Sample
steps.description: Extract the sample from the red box chamber.
steps.completion_voice: Sample extracted. Proceed to step six.

steps.label: Perform Experiment
steps.description: Conduct the experiment procedure with the sample.
steps.completion_voice: Experiment complete. Proceed to step seven.

steps.label: Close Box
steps.description: Close and seal the sample container.
steps.voice_prompt: Step seven: Close and seal the boxes.
steps.completion_voice: Boxes sealed. Proceed to final step.

steps.label: Store Components
steps.description: Return all components to the payload storage location.
steps.completion_voice: Experiment complete. All components stored. Well done.

error_messages.STEP_SKIPPED: Step {skipped_step} was skipped. Please complete step {skipped_step} first.
error_messages.OUT_OF_SEQUENCE: Action out of sequence. Please perform step {expected_step} first.
error_messages.REPEATED_ACTION: This step has already been completed. Proceeding to next step.
error_messages.UNCERTAIN: Unable to confidently identify the action. Please hold your position.
